description: This file defines the Mini pager plugin class for Drupal views, handling pagination with previous/next links and rendering logic.

classes.name: Mini
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class implementing a mini pager with previous/next links for views.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set default previous/next tags.

methods.name: summaryTitle
methods.description: Generates a summary title for the pager, indicating number of items and offset.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Modifies the view's query to fetch one extra item for pagination if needed.

methods.name: useCountQuery
methods.description: Indicates whether a count query is used; returns FALSE.

methods.name: postExecute
methods.description: Adjusts total items count after query execution and removes extra record if present.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Prepares the render array for the pager, including theme and navigation tags.
